text.content: Sprint 2 added intelligence to the Agentflow v2 through the ability to know what a consultant needs, retrieve the right information, and return a grounded response. Sprint 3 adds orchestration whcih is the ability to handle complex multi-step logic, retry failures automatically, process data iteratively, pause for human approval, and invoke sub-flows as modular components.
